info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Zoisitec Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Zoisitec Recliner Detail Management API enables users to create detailed catalog entries for the Zoisitec Recliner product. This endpoint allows businesses to enhance their product listings by adding vital specifications, features, and descriptions, thus ensuring customers have access to comprehensive information. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms, catalog management systems, and inventory control applications that aim to improve product visibility and sales. This API is essential for managing the product catalog efficiently and enhancing customer engagement through detailed product insights.

post.summary: Create details for a Zoisitec recliner.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create and store detailed information about a Zoisitec recliner. Ensure that all required fields are filled in the request body to successfully register the recliner's details.

requestBody.description: Payload containing the details for the zoisitec recliner operation. This body must include all required fields as specified in the schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, details have been returned.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the person requesting the operation.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request should be treated as a priority.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of a Zoisitec recliner.
